About this concept

Designed for a San Antonio practice

SmileBright Dental is a fictional brand used to demonstrate a dental website. Photos are illustrative; services, hours, names, and testimonials are sample content. This is not an operating clinic.

Demo privacy

The appointment preview does not send or store form entries. Images are embedded in this file. Google Fonts and the website host may process normal page requests; this is not a production patient portal.

Demo terms

No dental services, appointments, prices, or insurance benefits are offered here. Content is for design review, not medical advice.

Accessibility features

Includes keyboard navigation, visible focus indicators, labelled form fields, expandable FAQs, and reduced-motion support.
